signal: Waymark launched Waymark 2 and signed CBS, Fox, and Sky Media to roll out its AI ad-creation tech, having driven over $400M in local ad revenue

email.body1:
Hayden, saw Waymark sign CBS, Fox, and Sky Media to roll out Waymark 2 across local stations.

Landing broadcast partners at that scale usually opens more in-market advertisers and stations than the revenue team can personally cover, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Waymark off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Hayden, quick follow-up for Waymark.

As the broadcast rollouts expand, the pipeline target usually grows faster than headcount can. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Waymark needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Hayden, last bit of proof for Waymark.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Waymark's reply rate likely compares to other adtech startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Hayden, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Standing up multiple broadcast rollouts at once is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an adtech motion? I will tailor it to Waymark either way.
